full_judgment: 3. The opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff filed Title Suit No.  218 of 1991 before the Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka for permanent. injunction stating, inter-alia, that the suit land along, with other lands belonged to Kadam Mia, Kuran Mia, Nur Khatun, Abdul Malek, Asia Khatun and Ahmod Ali and from them Majharul Huq and others purchased the said land by a registered kabala in the year 1965. Majharul Huq and others mutated their names, obtained separate khatian arid used to possess the said land by paying rent in the government sherestha regularly. The R.S. khatian was prepared in the name of Majharul Huq and others correctly. Majharul Huq and others filed application for demarcation of their purchased land before the Circle Officer (Revenue), Savar on the basis of which Demarcation Case No. 21/1981-82 was started and upon field measurement they got their purchased land demarcated with specific boundary. Majharul Huq and others while possessing the said land sold out total 3.51 acres of land to the plaintiff by 13 kabalas of the year 1990 and the plaintiff since purchase has been possessing the said land. The plaintiff has also mutated his name in respect of the said land and has been paying rent regularly. The plaintiff has been possessing his purchased land by planting trees and growing crops thereon. Thus the plaintiff and his predecessors-the C.S. recorded tenant have been possessing the suit land for more than 50 years. That the defendant No. 1 being reedy person demanded bribe from the plaintiff on different pretext and being refused the defendant No. 1 threatened the plaintiff by some riotous people. On 25.06.1991 the defendant No. 1 along with some terrorists resisted the work of plaintiff's people on the suit land destroyed some trees and tried to evict the plaintiff from the said land and thus the plaintiff has been constrained to file the suit.
